ADDITIONAL INFORMATION FOR TYPE 1 REZONING APPLICATION
AT 1921-25 N. MILWAUKEE. CHICAGO. LL
FROM M1-1 TO B3-2

1. Narrative:

The property is improved with a 3-story mixed-use building. All existing improvements to remain
with no changes. The applicant is seeking to rezone the property from its existing MI-1
classification to a B3-2 classification to permit an art gallery in the first-floor commercial unit
commonly known as 1925 N. Milwaukee Avenue. The rezoning will also clarify the zoning map,
which currently shows the property as a split zoning lot with 1925 N. Milwaukee Avenue shown
as B3-5 and 1921 N. Milwaukee Avenue shown as MI-1. Following is the existing zoning
